verdict.rationale: Folk documents a REST API where deals are read and written through custom object endpoints, plus an official MCP server whose use cases include logging calls/meetings and bulk record updates. An agent could therefore write deal updates through either interface. However, nothing documents agent access to email or meeting signals. Gmail sync is a product feature, and no API or webhook surfaces email or meeting events to an agent. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of updating deal stage and next-step fields, API/MCP access to synced email and meeting data, webhook events for email/meeting activity, and hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end agent workflow.
